structural_change: QW-LAND8 10-19 (LEAD-QW 12:15: Q.STA.LAND600.3 = 8-slot D8 landing, contract 5a266752c; hybrid MODEL dee8d6b3a FF-ring class): new 1-b hop-0 landing master qfd_landh0d8_1_EW_15x15, hop-0 ICG on ck_s with the registered enable (main). D8 ring (8 slots, wc/rc mod 16, four K straps), en -> 2 registered stages before the ICG enable (no combinational enable into the gate), kept 16-bit regions, registered one-hot read selects. New master, no closed view. SAFE checklist (owner 10-19): 1 pins registered by construction (a -> bank flops, en -> en_s0, rs -> rs0, k -> k_q, b / fault = flops; reset 2 stages per side) | 2 reach: tile < 30 um | 3 fanout: selects <= 16 data loads, en_s0 / rs0 drive <= 2 + regions copies | 4 depth: ring -> o = 8:1 AND-OR, no in->out path | 5 storage: D8 direct FF ring <= 32 b (< 2 kb, hybrid MODEL dee8d6b3a FF class); wider lanes = SRAM record (INF.SRAM) | 6 floorplan: no macros, outline from the estimated synthesis area at ~45-55 % util, aspect <= 1.1 | 7 clock: two roots (ck, ck_s), ICG enable = en_icg.Q only (main) / no ICG (fallback n), ring -> o directly timed with the D8 envelope (land8_clocks.tcl), io_hold_margin 0.03 | 8 schedule: static, D8 K mod 16 four pins, en +2 / rs +2 release edges priced in K = (L + G - R0 - 1) mod 16 (QW-GEN3 notice)
